_help: Edit and save; both views pick changes up within a second. null = EcoLogits' default for the provider serving the model. PUE/WUE accept a number or [low, high].
_providers_help: Per-provider overrides, e.g. {"openai": {"electricity_zone": "USA", "datacenter_pue": 1.2}}. Providers: anthropic, openai, google_genai, mistralai, cohere, huggingface_hub.
_prefill_help: EcoLogits counts only output tokens. These weights add input tokens as 'output-token equivalents' (prefill is far cheaper per token than generation, cache reads cheaper still). Set all to 0 for pure EcoLogits numbers.
_sources_help: Which agents to read, and optionally where their data lives: null = the agent's default location (following its own environment variables), or a path, or a list of paths. Folders reported by session-start hooks and, under WSL, Windows-side installs are added automatically.
_launch_help: What `agent-footprint open` (run by the session-start hooks from `agent-footprint setup`) does. terminal: auto, or one of tmux, zellij, kitty, wezterm, terminator, iterm2, windows-terminal, gnome-terminal, konsole, apple-terminal, none. fallback when no terminal can be used: browser (start the dashboard and open it once) or none.
_compare_help: Also compare with one country's per-person average: an ISO 3166 alpha-3 code such as "NLD", "DEU" or "USA" (null = world only).
_titles_help: Name sessions after their first prompt: stores the first 90 characters of each session's first prompt in the history. Off by default; turning it off again erases stored titles. Project folder names are always stored.
